name: All-optical closed-loop control of human cardiomyocyte networks exploiting holographic optogenetics
citation: Wendland R, Schmieder F, Sikandar MA, et al. Communications Engineering. 2026;5:159. doi:10.1038/s44172-026-00779-1.
extracted_claim: Demonstrates real-time closed-loop optogenetic control of wavefront dynamics in human cardiomyocyte networks, supporting a future HeartTwin experimental-feedback interface.

name: Optogenetic tachypacing facilitates burst-induced arrhythmia in stem cell-derived human atrial engineered heart tissue
citation: Müller KF, Pan B, Ridder J, et al. Europace. 2026;28(8):euag158. doi:10.1093/europace/euag158.
extracted_claim: Shows that optogenetic pacing can impose controlled long-term rate stress in human atrial engineered tissue and generate measurable electrophysiologic and molecular remodeling.

name: Real-time GPU-accelerated coupled cardiac system: Integrating bidirectional interactions between living optogenetic monolayers and computational simulations
citation: Valibeigi Y, Kaboudian A, Fenton F, Bub G. PLoS Comput Biol. 2026;22(8):e1014590. doi:10.1371/journal.pcbi.1014590.
organism: Cardiac cell culture with computational model
assay: real-time optical mapping and optogenetic feedback
extracted_claim: Demonstrates bidirectional coupling between living cardiac tissue and a GPU-accelerated simulation, directly supporting the architecture of a model-to-experiment optical feedback loop.

name: Electrical coupling between transplanted cardiomyocytes and host myocardium to prevent arrhythmia
citation: Guragain B, Ye L, Rogers JM, Zhang JJ. Dis Model Mech. 2026;19(6):dmm052768. doi:10.1242/dmm.052768.
assay: review of graft-host electrical integration methods
extracted_claim: Identifies optical mapping and optogenetic stimulation as useful experimental tools for studying graft maturation, host-graft coupling and post-transplant arrhythmia risk in cardiac regeneration.

name: Recellularized Humanized Bioengineered Biatrial Model for Arrhythmia, Biological Pacemakers, and Optogenetic Studies
citation: Ghiringhelli M, Shiff D, Grinstein H, et al. Circ Res. 2026;138(10):e326884. doi:10.1161/CIRCRESAHA.125.326884.
organism: Human cells in bioengineered atrial tissue
assay: optogenetic pacing, programmed stimulation and optical mapping
extracted_claim: Shows optogenetic pacing and cardioversion in an anatomically structured humanized atrial model, supporting spatial protocol metadata in future tissue-scale digital-twin experiments.

name: Spatially Resolved Photostimulation of Cardiac Activity Using Optoelectronic Peptides
citation: Lundqvist EM, Nguyen K, Chung CO, et al. ACS Cent Sci. 2026;12(9):1394-1409. doi:10.1021/acscentsci.6c00713.
extracted_claim: Demonstrates a non-genetic optoelectronic route to spatial cardiac photostimulation, justifying a modality-neutral optical-stimulation contract rather than an opsin-only interface.
